item.title: Buffalo water customers face new fee as city tackles aging infrastructure crisis
item.description: Buffalo Water Authority customers are seeing a new quarterly "Infrastructure Improvement Charge" on their water bills as the city embarks on a $400M, six-year plan to fix its aging water system.

item.title: 'Absolutely long overdue': Buffalo takes a key step in $70M Main Street reconstruction project
item.description: The City of Buffalo has completed the bidding process for a massive road reconstruction project aimed at revitalizing a 2.5-mile stretch of Main Street in Downtown Buffalo.

item.title: Family and sources claim rooms in Williamsville long-term care facility kept cold to manage roof leaks
item.description: Family members of a resident at Comprehensive Rehab of Williamsville and employees claim the facility kept rooms cold in an effort to prevent snow from melting and worsening roof leaks.

item.title: 'Long way to go': $1.75M settlement reached for survivors, family members of victims of Buffalo mass shooting
item.description: Some justice was served for survivors and family members of victims of the racist mass shooting at Tops on Jefferson Avenue, as Attorney General Letitia James announced a settlement was reached.
